claude.title: Claude (claude.ai) Setup
claude.step2: Scroll down and click <bold>Add custom connector</bold>
claude.step5: You will be redirected to sign in with your LearnForge credentials

ankiImport.title: Import from Anki
ankiImport.intro: Bring an Anki deck into LearnForge: decks become topics, note types keep their fields, templates and styling, and every card keeps its schedule. Media, review history and Anki's settings are kept as well.
ankiImport.pickHint: Export a deck in Anki (File → Export → Anki Deck Package) and choose the file here.
ankiImport.limits: Up to 200 MB and 100,000 notes. All Anki versions are supported.

ankiImport.startFailed: The import could not be started.
ankiImport.discardFailed: The import could not be removed.

ankiImport.unsupportedHint: Image occlusion notes are imported and kept, but left out of study until LearnForge can draw them.
